per_finding.notes: Original probe (state.trivial_file=$SR/../../victim, SessionStart startup) deletes ~/victim on base 02eff38 and leaves it intact on eadf8bd. Attacked 13 variants through session-start (rm) and record-skill (append): symlinked parent dir, leaf symlink out, sub/../outlink, '..', './..', '//..//', nonexist/../../.., loop/../../.., ~/.claude/./.silver-bullet/../.., '~/...' forms, trailing slash: all SAFE (REVF-F1b-probe/scripts/p2-variants.sh). Unit matrix of ~55 inputs (u1-state.sh): '..', root itself, '$SR/.', '$SR/..', symlink loops (self, 2-cycle), dangling-out link, relative/absolute/chained links, nonexistent components, spaces/unicode/tab, CR/LF rejected, relative rejected, symlinked state root (accepted canonically, escape rejected), root->/ rejected, extra roots validated: all correct. Honest in-root paths (custom state file, ~ state file, sub/../x) still work. Residual (by design, R3-02/G1): a configured in-root trivial_file is still deleted by session-start.

Original probe (state_file ~/.claude/.silver-bullet/../../profile-victim) appends 'silver-plan' on base, untouched on fix; skill lands in the default state file. Fixed in the shared predicate, so all 20+ callers benefit; env override SILVER_BULLET_STATE_FILE=$SR/outlink/v also rejected. Mutation check: restoring the string-prefix accept makes test-state-path-containment 4 passed/14 failed and test-runtime-paths 90/14.

Partial by design and correctly scoped: session-start graphify/agentmemory clears and record-graphify-query no longer touch ~/.bashrc_victim/.gitconfig_victim/.profile_victim (base: deleted/overwritten). The unscoped token-compression usage_state_file path (the RTK overwrite in R5-01) and the 'declare -f'-conditional checks in graphify/agentmemory/leanctx libs remain; they belong to H4a per PKG-NOTES (which already says to use sb_runtime_state_path). Severity of the remainder is still critical until H4a lands.

Partial disposition is sound (shared emitters now emit only documented fields, one JSON document, hookEventName whenever hookSpecificOutput is present, never permissionDecision allow - verified with hostile strings for jq/python3 paths and a 'decision allow/approve/ALLOW/Allow' matrix; mutation emitting allow fails test-hook-output). But the new Bash encoder is broken on Bash <= 4.2 (issue 1), and the Cursor bridge change overrides deny reasons with notices (issue 4). Note also: timeout-check's STALL BLOCK / stall warnings are model-directed but now go to systemMessage, which Claude shows only to the user; R3-21's proposed fix asked for additionalContext where the model must see the text (no regression vs base, which used the undocumented message field).

Fixed on Bash >= 4.3: in an SB project without jq, 'sudo apt-get install -y jq', 'brew install jq', read-only commands pass; completion-audit no longer denies Skill calls; non-SB repos are inert (git commit / echo deploy allowed). Bypass attempts all still blocked by at least one PreToolUse hook (p6-nojq-bypass.sh: 'brew install jq; git commit', newline, '&', '|', $(...), backticks, '|| git push', '&& git commit', echo $(git commit), find -exec, awk system(), git -c alias, env/\git, codex cmd arrays). 'Outside SB' is decided by walking from the hook's $PWD for .silver-bullet.json + silver-bullet.md (no root cache), which the agent cannot change without a write the gates deny. Incomplete: on macOS Bash 3.2 compound remediation ('brew install jq && jq --version', 'sudo apt-get update; ...', 'command -v jq || brew install jq') is denied, and with python3 also missing completion-audit's deny is invalid JSON (issue 1); the allowlist is wider than 'install or probe jq' (issue 3); the block message says read-only commands are allowed although they are denied without python3 (issue 6). Skill calls stay denied by forbidden-skill-check/uat-gate (reasoned fail-closed; acceptable).

The literal case (env path outside the root, /tmp fallback, symlinked branch file) is fixed. But session-start still calls sb_branch_scope_write without the validated path (hooks/session-start:274,316), and sb_branch_scope_file re-derives the path with a different validator/spelling (sb_runtime_state_path: expands '~', strips trailing '/', canonicalises) than session-start's literal sb_runtime_path_is_state_scoped path. For SILVER_BULLET_BRANCH_FILE='~/.claude/.silver-bullet/branch-tilde', '$SR/branch2/' or '$SR/nonexist/../branch3' the exact R3-27 failure reproduces: write goes to one file, read to another, 'branch file write failed' on every start, and a branch switch is NOT detected (recorded skills survive into the new branch). Issue 2.

issues.problem: New code relies on Bash >= 4.3 quote removal of the replacement string in double-quoted pattern substitution ("${s//"$bs"/"$bs$bs"}", "${cmd//"$and_op"/"$nl"}"). In Bash <= 4.2 (macOS /bin/bash 3.2, RHEL/CentOS 7 bash 4.2) the quotes are kept literally (documented as compat42). Effects: (a) _sb_hook_json_bash produces invalid JSON for any text containing \ " newline CR tab or control chars, so every emitter's last-resort path (no jq, no python3) emits invalid JSON; completion-audit's jq-missing delivery deny, which on base fell back to a valid static deny, is now invalid (regression; dev-cycle-check's own static deny still blocks); (b) _sb_jq_allowed_without_jq inserts literal quotes when splitting on && || ;, so compound jq installs are denied on macOS without jq - the recovery path R1-29 promises. These are the only quoted-replacement constructs in hooks/; there is no macOS CI and the tests assert the opposite behaviour.
issues.evidence: BASH_COMPAT=32 (and 42) emulation. REVF-F1b-probe/scripts/p4-output.sh mode bash32: all 7 emitter calls -> 'INVALID Expecting , delimiter' (default bash: OK, round-trips). p5-compat.sh: COMPAT=32 NOBOTH completion-audit 'git push' -> 'INVALID JSON => {"hookSpecificOutput":{..."permissionDecision":"deny",...' ; COMPAT=32 NOJQ dev-cycle-check 'brew install jq && jq --version' -> deny, 'sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq' -> deny (default bash: allowed). Test files under BASH_COMPAT=32: test-jq-gate.sh 48 passed/6 failed (4 compound remediation cases, 'no python3: escaped command is not trusted' -> invalid JSON, 'delivery without python3: still blocked' -> invalid JSON); test-hook-output.sh 41/4 ('message via bash: nasty string round-trips', 'failing python3 falls back to the Bash encoder', 'message_json without jq or python3', 'decision via bash encoder'). Unit: BASH_COMPAT=32 _sb_hook_json_bash 'a\b"c<nl>d' -> "a"\""\"\""b...
issues.suggested_fix: Avoid double-quoted replacement strings in hooks/. For the split, drop the outer quotes: segs=${cmd//"$and_op"/"$nl"} (verified identical under BASH_COMPAT=32/42 and 5.2). For the encoder, escape with a prefix/suffix loop instead of pattern replacement, e.g. while [[ $s == *"$ch"* ]]; do out=$out${s%%"$ch"*}$rep; s=${s#*"$ch"}; done (verified round-trip under BASH_COMPAT=32 and default). Add a BASH_COMPAT=32 pass of test-hook-output.sh and test-jq-gate.sh (or a lint rule banning //"..."/"..." in hooks/), and make test-lib-small-helpers' no-jq/no-python3 deny assertion validate JSON instead of assert_contains.

issues.problem: R3-27 variant: read and write still use different paths whenever the two validators disagree on spelling. session-start reads/checks the literal path accepted by sb_runtime_path_is_state_scoped (or the default when the literal is not absolute), but sb_branch_scope_write (called without the new FILE argument) writes to sb_branch_scope_file = sb_runtime_state_path(SILVER_BULLET_BRANCH_FILE), which expands '~', strips trailing '/' and resolves 'missing/..'.
issues.evidence: REVF-F1b-probe/scripts/p3-branch.sh: SILVER_BULLET_BRANCH_FILE='~/.claude/.silver-bullet/branch-tilde' -> session-start warns 'branch file write failed at .../.silver-bullet/branch', branch-tilde=[feature/test|...]; after git checkout -b <new> with state 'silver-plan' -> 'branch change NOT detected; state=[silver-plan ]'. Same for "$SR/branch2/" and "$SR/nonexist/../branch3"; "$SR/./branch4" behaves correctly.
issues.suggested_fix: Have one validator and one spelling: sb_branch_scope_file should return the literal SILVER_BULLET_BRANCH_FILE when sb_runtime_path_is_state_scoped accepts it (else $SB_RUNTIME_STATE_DIR/branch), and/or session-start should pass "$branch_file" as the new third argument at both sb_branch_scope_write calls. Add the tilde and trailing-slash cases to test-branch-scope.sh.

issues.problem: The jq-missing allowlist is wider than 'install or probe jq': any VAR=value prefix with [-A-Za-z0-9_./:@%+,=] values is accepted (PATH=, BASH_ENV=, LD_PRELOAD=, DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES=, so brew - a bash script - or apt-get can be made to run repository code), and dnf/yum/zypper 'update' is a full system upgrade, not a metadata refresh. Not a new bypass class (with jq present, running a script that commits is not delivery-inspected either), but it contradicts the stated 'strict jq installs' policy and lets the agent run unvetted code while the gates are degraded.
issues.evidence: _sb_jq_allowed_without_jq: ALLOWED 'sudo dnf update -y', 'sudo yum update -y', 'sudo zypper update', 'BASH_ENV=./x.sh brew install jq', 'DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES=./x.dylib brew install jq'; through the hooks (p6): 'BASH_ENV=./evil.sh brew install jq', 'PATH=./bin:/usr/bin brew install jq', 'LD_PRELOAD=./x.so apt-get update' -> completion-audit allow, dev-cycle-check allow.
issues.suggested_fix: Allow no env prefixes, or only an allowlist (DEBIAN_FRONTEND, HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE, HOMEBREW_NO_INSTALL_CLEANUP, NONINTERACTIVE); keep 'update' only for apt/apt-get. Add negative tests.

issues.problem: The bridge now copies a top-level systemMessage into hookSpecificOutput.message even when a permissionDecision deny is present; the later 'elif message' branch then overwrites agent_message, so in Cursor the agent sees the notice instead of the deny reason. sb_emit_hook_decision deliberately emits deny + systemMessage when NOTICE is given (advertised as the emitter for R2-01). Also a Stop notice (sb_emit_hook_context Stop -> systemMessage) becomes followup_message, which Cursor auto-submits as a new user turn. Latent: no current caller uses either shape.
issues.evidence: Stub hook printing sb_emit_hook_decision PreToolUse deny 'REAL REASON' '' 'just a notice' -> {"hookSpecificOutput":{..."permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"REAL REASON"},"systemMessage":"just a notice"}. Base bridge: {"permission":"deny","agent_message":"REAL REASON",...}; fixed bridge: {"permission":"deny","agent_message":"just a notice","user_message":"REAL REASON"}. sb_emit_hook_context Stop 'fyi context' -> bridge stop -> {"followup_message":"fyi context"}.
issues.suggested_fix: Map systemMessage only when there is no permissionDecision (or never let message overwrite agent_message on a deny; append instead), and do not turn plain notices into followup_message on stop. Add a deny+notice bridge test.

issues.problem: sb_path_is_within (the API offered to G2 for R2-18/R2-35) returns 2 'undecidable' as soon as the lexical spelling hits a symlink loop, even when the physical/kernel answer is 'inside' was already computed; a deny guard written with the natural 'if sb_path_is_within ...; then deny' idiom then allows a write that lands in the protected root. The union-of-forms semantics is also only safe for deny-if-inside guards and must never grant access; the header does not say so.
issues.evidence: proj/a -> proj/sub/deeper, proj/sub/L -> proj/.planning, proj/L -> L (self loop); target proj/a/../L/ROADMAP.md: sb_path_is_within rc=2, sb_canonical_path -> proj/.planning/ROADMAP.md, python realpath -> proj/.planning/ROADMAP.md, 'echo hacked > target' overwrote .planning/ROADMAP.md.
issues.suggested_fix: Return 0 when the physical form is inside regardless of lexical-form failures (return 2 only when the physical resolution itself fails), or make the predicate deny-oriented (any loop -> 0). Document that it is a deny-guard predicate and must not be used to allow. Optionally resolve the deepest existing ancestor with cd -P/pwd -P so non-ASCII case/normalisation variants on APFS match.
